No. The 67.7 ha tree-cover loss was recorded in **2020**, before the 31 December 2020 cut-off.

No loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on the property during 2021–2025. The data did show 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021. Small or narrow changes may have been missed, and the assessment does not establish EUDR compliance.
